technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong MACD/PPO crossovers and bullish candlestick pattern offset by weak intermediate trend structure and price below key moving averages; moderate confluence suggests caution on entry sizing.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (361.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 38 days adding execution risk.
